page.overview:
Who is Catherine?

Catherine is the fictional receptionist at the Ocean Club in Nassau, Bahamas. A minor character and Bond girl portrayed by British actress, Christina Cole, she appeared briefly in the 2006 James Bond film, Casino Royale.

Catherine appears when James Bond is checking into the club after investigating a lead on who hired a bomb maker in Madagascar. She recommends a villa with an ocean view which Bond accepts. He then tells her that he was at the club for dinner the previous night and accidentally nicked the door of a 1964 Aston Martin DB5 whose owner her does not know. She tells him that it belongs to Alex Dimitrios and recommends not mentioning it if it hasn't been noticed, since Dimitrios has a considerable temper, but gives him his address in case he feels compelled to find him. She doesn't appear afterwards.

Christina Cole previously portrayed Bond girls in screentests.
